config.theme.description: Theme applied inside the embedded OpenCode web UI.
config.theme.enum.codex.label: Match Codex (beige)
config.theme.enum.codex.description: Use the fixed Codex-style palette: one unified beige page (#F2F1EA), a white composer (#FFFFFF), neutral text (#292929 / #656563) and a light auxiliary tone (#ECEBE4), with a matching dark variant when VS Code is dark.
config.theme.enum.vscode.label: Follow VS Code theme
config.theme.enum.vscode.description: Follow the active VS Code color theme by reading the live theme colors from the webview; updates live when the theme changes. Falls back to the Codex palette while colors are unavailable.
config.theme.enum.native.label: OpenCode native theme
config.theme.enum.native.description: Leave OpenCode's own theme and color scheme untouched.
config.theme.enum.beige.label: Beige (deprecated alias)
config.theme.enum.beige.description: Deprecated alias for "codex"; kept so existing settings keep working.
